answer: We use a mirror cluster audit: after settlement, timing and counterparty graphs are compared against a velvet baseline, and identities whose similarity exceeds a fixed threshold are frozen and their rewards reversed. The enforcement rule is a rolling 30-day review that flags any identity matching another on more than 80% of its interaction fingerprints. Each flagged identity must then pay a concrete 20-minute manual review and a $0.25 revalidation fee before its mesa balance unlocks.
